node.statement: Coefficient-margin guards: put e=epsilon_r, x=e+delta, and z=e+r. By the definition of an epsilon_r-C*-algebra e>=0, while delta>0 and r>0, so x,z>=0. Since C_ch^I,C_ch^G<=C_ch^0<=C_ch and kappa_ch<=kappa_ch^0<=kappa_ch^I,kappa_ch^G, the root graph guard implies C_ch^I*x<=kappa_ch^I and C_ch^G*x<=kappa_ch^G. The identical max/min argument gives C_pol^q*x<=kappa_pol^q for q in {I,P,A}, and C_der^I*z<=kappa_der^I.
